title: The Samsung Android device must be provisioned as a fully managed device and configured to create a work profile.
check_content:
Verify requirement KNOX-16-008800 (COPE enrollment) has been implemented.

If "COPE enrollment" has not been implemented, this is a finding."
VulnDiscussion:
The Android Enterprise work profile is the designated application group for the COPE use case.

SFR ID: FMT_SMF.1.1 #47
